title: The curators: a librarian and a curator per model type place every record, a guarded write checks each placement, Claude only in shadow
request: An agentic system that puts the right data for each model in the right place: a curator per model type, validated output, Claude where it measures better, in shadow first.
plan: Rules per model type: which records fit, the folder, the quality.
One guarded write: the layout, the contract, consent, a silver label never kept as confirmed.
Claude's placements in shadow, kept and never used.
Curate only record files that changed.

decisions.decision: Claude's curator is one completion per batch, not a tool loop.
decisions.why: Placing a record is a classification; a loop would cost more and decide nothing more.

decisions.decision: The model sees each record's shape only.
decisions.why: Names and short codes are enough to place it; no value needs to leave.

change: dclab_rnd.store.curators (place, librarian, curate), curators.write (check), curators.model (ask, shape_of), the purpose store_curator and its prompt, the conductor's curate step.

findings.defect: A label with no point was placed nowhere.
findings.scenario: A test label without its point.
findings.fix: The test labels carry their points, as the ledger's do.

findings.defect: Duplicates were not caught across runs.
findings.scenario: A log kept whole again doubled M1's rows.
findings.cause: The seen set lived one run.

findings.defect: The guarded write let any folder through and dropped a malformed reply.
findings.cause: Only the path's syntax was checked.
findings.fix: Each model type's own folders; a failed answer kept.

findings.defect: A command-line tool's model requests were not logged.
findings.scenario: The first live curator run: two requests, none in the usage log.
findings.cause: installed() falls back to a Gateway without a usage log outside the server.
findings.fix: models.for_tools(): the server's gateway, else one logging to the workspace's usage log; the curator and the teacher use it.

findings.defect: The model curator's replies were cut short.
findings.scenario: A batch of 20: a 515-character reply, then an empty one.
findings.cause: The default reply limit (1800 tokens) is too small for a batch's placements.

findings.defect: The shadow comparison counted candidate model types, not the rules' placements.
findings.cause: librarian() lists candidates; place() returns None where a record does not belong.
findings.fix: Sample records the rules placed; compare with their placements; count what the model left out.

measurements.name: the model curator in shadow, live
measurements.gate: promoted only when it agrees with the rules' placements and measures better on a person's review; until then shadow
measurements.result: 40 records the rules placed: a rules' model type named 26 of 34 answers, the same quality 2 of 26, 21 of 47 rules' placements left out, 6 records unanswered
measurements.next: a person reviews a sample of the disagreements: whether the rules or the model place better
limits: one sample of 40 from development workspaces
the rules are not the truth: a person's review is

outcome: Every record is placed for the models it can teach, with its quality and reason, each placement checked; Claude's answers wait in shadow.
lessons: Show a model the shape of a record, not its content, when the shape decides.
risks: The rules' placements are first choices, unmeasured against a person's review.
